decisions.reason: The enclosed laser marking workstation extends the firm's in-house laser coding expertise to manual applications, so the firm can readily interpret market feedback and refine the multi-model line.
High-resolution thermal inkjet is a core coding technology closely related to the firm's existing knowledge and consumables business, and its dedicated web page signals strategic commitment.

The piezo inkjet printer builds on the firm's inkjet and integration know-how, filling a surface-specific niche that its in-house R&D can continue to improve, which fits its technology-matching strategy.
